WITH country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall_countries AS (
  SELECT country, avg_wins
  FROM country_avg_wins
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_calc)
),
above_group_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_group_avg FROM above_overall_countries
),
final_filtered_countries AS (
  SELECT country, avg_wins
  FROM above_overall_countries
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT above_group_avg FROM above_group_avg_calc)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_wins) as mean_of_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_calc)) as mean_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(avg_wins - (SELECT above_group_avg FROM above_group_avg_calc)) as mean_excess_over_above_group
FROM final_filtered_countries;
